title: Report unequal exposure and no-learning-signal ties
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs equal rollout counts to still reveal unequal token and call exposure, and to flag all-success ties that provide no learning contrast. Accepts FineEnvs exposure and discriminative-value findings[^fineenvs-exposure].
implementation: `ExposureLedger` in `mechaharness.exposure_accounting` and `discriminative_report` in `mechaharness.discriminative_value` summarize arm exposure and tie telemetry.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
